title: ME61006: Rail Vehicle Dynamics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Objectives: This course aims to develop an understanding of the dynamic
interaction between the rail vehicle and track that is essential for a railway
engineer. This course focuses on rail vehicle stability, vehicle ride comfort,
hunting and conicity, rail-wheel contact, wheel and rail wear and derailment
safety. Credit: {(3-1-0) 4 credits}Syllabus: Introduction; Track components,
geometry and flexibility; Rail Vehicles, vehicle-track interaction; Dynamic
Analysis techniques; Advanced vehicle modelling; Wheel-rail guidance mechanism;
Creep and creep forces – dynamic stability and curving; Track forces and
derailment; Wheel –rail wear; Ride comfort; Vehicle gauging; Different bogie
designs; Experimental Techniques and Validation.Teachers: Prof. Anirvan Dasgupta,
Prof. Kingshook Bhattacharyya.References: Handbook of Vehicle Dynamics by Simon Iwmicki
